BBQ Ribs Recipe Ingredients- • 2 racks of pork ribs • 1-4 cup brown sugar • 1-4 cup paprik (aa7fda)notemigrated11/15/2026BBQ Ribs Recipe Ingredients: • 2 racks of pork ribs • 1/4 cup brown sugar • 1/4 cup paprika • 1 tablespoon black pepper • 1 tablespoon salt • 1 tablespoon chili powder • 1 tablespoon garlic powder • 1 tablespoon onion powder • 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper • 1 cup BBQ sauce (your favorite brand or homemade) Instructions: 1. Prepare the Ribs: ◦ Remove the membrane from the back of the ribs for better flavor absorption. ◦ Rinse the ribs under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels. 2. Make the Dry Rub: ◦ In a bowl, mix together the brown sugar, paprika, black pepper, salt, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, and cayenne pepper. 3. Season the Ribs: ◦ Generously rub the spice mixture all over the ribs, ensuring they are well coated. ◦ Wrap the ribs in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, preferably overnight. 4. Preheat the Grill: ◦ Preheat your grill to 225°F (107°C) for low and slow cooking. If using a charcoal grill, set it up for indirect heat. 5. Cook the Ribs: ◦ Place the ribs on the grill, bone side down. Close the lid and cook for about 3 hours. ◦ After 3 hours, wrap the ribs in aluminum foil and cook for another 2 hours. 6. Add the BBQ Sauce: ◦ Remove the ribs from the foil and brush them with BBQ sauce. ◦ Place the ribs back on the grill and cook for an additional 30 minutes to 1 hour, basting with more BBQ sauce every 15 minutes. 7. Serve: ◦ Once the ribs are tender and the sauce is caramelized, remove them from the grill. ◦ Let the ribs rest for a few minutes before slicing and serving. Enjoy your delicious BBQ ribs! 🍖🔥 Do you have any favorite sides you like to pair with BBQ ribs?11/15/2026
